inference.method: customer-cluster delta-method sandwich SE, m/(m-1) correction, one-sided t(m-1) approximation
inference.triple_contrasts: joint_AB_C/antecedent_AB minus each singleton confidence separately
inference.triple_combined_p: maximum of association p and both incremental p-values (intersection-union test)
inference.family: within each system (control, method, seed), union of all selected rule-by-evaluation-scope hypotheses across five configs and three budgets; native and shared roles included and exact duplicates collapsed
inference.primary_adjustment: Benjamini-Yekutieli; BH also exported as exploratory sensitivity
inference.confidence_intervals: pointwise 95% t intervals for uplift/increment, not simultaneous intervals
inference.limits: Asymptotic, not exact. Adjustments are within system, not across 222 system comparisons. No confirmatory global significance claim.

scope.restricted: quality assessed in original assigned group; matching restricted to that group
scope.shared: quality recomputed on all 4862 eligible Validation baskets; deduplicate shared rule identity; repeated source slots do not return budget

metrics.accepted_slot_share: accepted deployed slots / original actual slots, not only evaluable rules
metrics.accepted_unique_rule_share: accepted unique (scope, rule) / selected unique (scope, rule)
metrics.quality_coverage: union of orders jointly matching accepted rules / all eligible orders; retrospective persistence, not prospective deployment performance
metrics.quality_customer_macro_coverage: mean over active customers of their quality-covered order share
metrics.evaluable_share: enough orders and customers and no >50% single-customer joint concentration
metrics.temporal_changes: Validation minus Discovery confidence, lift ratio and confidence ratio; descriptive, no same-customer cross-period CI claimed
